rows.q: How early can I renew my residence permit?
rows.answer: You can renew your resident permit online up to 30 days before its expiry [faq-01]. You will need a valid passport, a recent photo, and your Nova ID for the process [faq-01]. The processing time for the renewal is 3 working days [faq-01].

rows.q: Can I bring my mother to live with me on my residency?
rows.answer: <faq-02] Yes, you can sponsor your mother if you earn at least 8,000 NCD per month. You need to submit the family sponsorship form along with a tenancy contract and proof of your salary. This process allows you to bring your mother to live with you under your residency.

rows.q: I lost my ID card, what should I do?
rows.answer: You should report your lost Nova ID card online within 7 days [faq-03]. A replacement card will cost 150 NCD and will be delivered by courier within 5 working days [faq-03].

rows.q: What happens if I stay after my permit expires?
rows.answer: If your resident permit expires, you have a grace period of 30 days [faq-04]. After this period, a daily overstay fee of 50 NCD will be charged until the permit is renewed [faq-04]. You can renew your permit online up to 30 days before expiry [faq-01].

rows.q: How much does it cost to renew a driving licence?
rows.answer: The renewal fee for a driving licence is 120 NCD, and an eye test certificate from an approved optician is required [faq-05]. You can renew your driving licence either online or at any service centre [faq-05].

rows.q: I sold my car, how do I move it to the buyer's name?
rows.answer: To transfer vehicle ownership, both you (seller) and the buyer must sign the transfer request in the app [faq-06]. The vehicle must pass inspection and have no unpaid fines [faq-06]. Ensure all requirements are met before initiating the transfer.

rows.q: Is there a discount for paying a parking ticket early?
rows.answer: Yes, there is a 25 percent discount for paying a traffic and parking fine within 30 days [faq-07]. You can pay through the Nova City app, at kiosks, or at service centers [faq-07]. Service centers are open Monday to Friday from 7:30 to 15:30, with the central one also open on Saturdays from 8:00 to 12:00 [faq-11].

rows.q: Can I swap my licence from abroad without a driving test?
rows.answer: Yes, holders of licenses from approved countries can convert to a Nova City license without a road test [faq-08]. You need to bring the original license, a translation, and an eye test certificate [faq-08]. There is no mention of needing to be in Nova City to perform this conversion.

rows.q: How many books can I borrow?
rows.answer: Members can borrow up to 6 books for 3 weeks [faq-09]. Library cards are free for residents and can be applied for online or at any branch with your Nova ID [faq-09].

rows.q: When is the service centre open on weekends?
rows.answer: The central service centre opens on Saturday from 8:00 to 12:00 [faq-11].
